preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of cities N must be between 1 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(Ai) <= 50 and 1 <= len(Bi) <= 50 for Ai, Bi, Ci in cards)
preconditions.description: The lengths of city names Ai and Bi must be between 1 and 50 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Ci <= 1000 for Ai, Bi, Ci in cards)
preconditions.description: The cost Ci for each card must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: len(set(Ai for Ai, Bi, Ci in cards)) == N and len(set(Bi for Ai, Bi, Ci in cards)) == N - 1
preconditions.description: All city names must be unique, and there must be N-1 unique destination cities.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join(f'{Ai} {Bi} {Ci}' for Ai, Bi, Ci in sorted_cards) + f'\n{total_cost}'
postconditions.description: The output must contain the cards in the correct order followed by the total cost of the journey.

postconditions.expression: total_cost == sum(Ci for Ai, Bi, Ci in sorted_cards)
postconditions.description: The total cost must be the sum of the costs of all cards in the correct order.
